methodology.calibration_dataset: a staged local snapshot of the cnn_dailymail training split
methodology.evaluation_scope: A deterministic 32-row slice from the same CNN/DailyMail training split. It contains 31 unique text payloads because staged rows 1026 and 1029 have identical content hashes; deduplicating that repeated text leaves every reported rank unchanged. This is suitable for a controlled numerical screen, not broad task or corpus generalization.
methodology.fixed_shape_reason: Outer batch and padded sequence shapes are matched for control; a research-only pre-hook refreshes block reshape caches per invocation for variable fused-MoE routed-token shapes.
methodology.reference_policy: Generate BF16 reference logits once per exact model/config revision, tokenizer, sample ordering, sequence length, dtype, source/runtime/container/GPU identity, and resolved device map; persist them before in-place fake quantization.
methodology.metric_policy: Mask padding and aggregate per valid next-token position. Qwen normalized MSE is the mean of tokenwise centered-MSE/reference-variance ratios. Report raw and normalized logit error, forward/reverse KL, Jensen-Shannon divergence, target-token log-probability error, NLL delta, and top-k agreement.
methodology.layer_policy: Measure every mapped weight and fused-expert slice directly through its ModelOpt TensorQuantizer; use compute_quantization_mse for inputs over 32 packed calibration rows. Retain per-layer plus family summaries and fail on incomplete eligible coverage. Input hook-call averages and family averages are not element-weighted.

interpretation_guardrails: Treat the W8A8 matrix as a format-level comparison, not a causal granularity ablation: per-tensor activations use a static calibrated scale, block-128 and MXFP8 activations use dynamic per-invocation scaling, and MXFP8 additionally changes block size and scale encoding.

The W8A16 controls isolate activation-quantization scope, but they do not isolate every format choice: MXFP8 versus block-128 still combines 32-value versus 128/128x128 scale domains with E8M0 versus full-precision scale representation.

The 32 CNN/DailyMail evaluation rows form a deterministic same-split numerical screen and contain 31 unique texts because rows 1026 and 1029 duplicate content; deduplication leaves every reported rank unchanged. Do not generalize their ordering to downstream tasks, other corpora, or full model quality.

Qwen normalized MSE is a mean of per-token ratios. The synthetic toy uses one ratio of global element means, so the two normalized-MSE values are conceptually related but not numerically interchangeable.
The dynamic block-128 candidate is a numerical simulation using full-precision dynamic scales, not evidence of an exportable or accelerated runtime format.
Raw vocabulary-logit MSE depends on logit offset and scale; centered/variance-normalized MSE and distribution divergences are the cross-model anchors.
AutoQuant KL is useful for candidate ranking but is a raw summed internal score; it is not substituted for token-normalized end-to-end KL.
No Qwen3.6 number appears in the report unless it was parsed from a result artifact.
